dates.text: non julii anno à nativitate Domini millesisimo quadringentesio, qua sexco pontificatus nostrisanno dexto

data.summary: Pope Felix V grants an indulgence of 41 days to those who contribute alms for the repair and conservation of the hospital in Faverrier, which was damaged by brigands and is currently in need of restoration.
